content: He who carries a burden of worries on his head will surely sink when crossing the turbulent river of worldly life.
author: Kabir
explanation: Overthinking and anxious grasping weigh the consciousness down. Crossing the river of life safely requires letting go of useless psychological baggage and traveling light in faith.
practicalInsight: Identify your single heaviest mental worry right now. Hand it over to universal intelligence and take your next step unburdened.
reflectionPrompt: What heavy worry am I refusing to put down?
